The fellowship groups gather each week to study the Word of God, build social capital and repay microfinance loans.

name: Frederic
description: Frederic is a 28-year-old man from Gakenke District in the Northern Province of Rwanda.  He is seeking a top-up loan of 30,000 Rwanda Francs (RWF) to purchase 10 more rechargeable LED lights, which he will resell to people without electricity in his village. Every week or so, these customers will return to him to have their lights recharged for just 100 RWF.  Frederic started selling lights in December, 2012 and he has sold 20 lights to date, providing clean energy to 100 people. His light-recharging business has been fully funded by Kiva. With the money he makes from selling and recharging lights, he will pay for the school fees of his 5 children.

name: Suraie
description: Suraie lives in Shahrinav.  She is married and has two children.  She has a secondary education.   For more than ten years, Suraie has been working in a cafe assisting the cooks.  She is taking out a loan to buy foodstuffs and new dishes for the cafe.

name: Fadiaye
description: Fadiaye S. lives in Camberene and is a client parent.  She is a merchant of shoes, gold-plated jewelry, and various other items for women.  She has five years of experience in this business and wishes to increase her number of customers and to conquer other markets.Translated from French by Dan Kuey, Kiva Volunteer

name: Carolina Fabiola
description: Carolina is a 23-years old woman who lives in the city of Nazca with her partner and her young son. She is hardworking, enthusiastic, and she is putting all her effort in to get ahead. Unfortunately, due to a lack of economic resources and because she has to work, Carolina can't pursue a professional career.  On her own initiative, Carolina works selling beauty products. She works every day for about 10 hours walking the streets to sell her products. Carolina is comfortable doing her work and she thinks that it is going well for her as a result of her dedication and effort.  Carolina is very grateful for Kiva lenders. Thanks to the assistance provided, she will carry out the process to improve the bathroom in her home. This will allow her and her family to have more comfort. Carolina will keep working and striving to achieve her big dream to have safe and adequate housing.

name: Shabana
description: Shabana, age 42, is a vigorous lady. She has been running a boutique business for many years. She buys cloths of different fabrics in various colors and designs from the market and, after doing embroidery, she sells them to the people of her community. She has a varied customer base and is able to earn enough through her business. Shabana is requesting a 40,000 PKR loan from the Kashf Foundation to buy a wide variety of cloth, sequins and beads with spools of thread to inflate her sales. She is in her 8th loan cycle with Kashf Foundation.

name: Primera Vez Group
description: The communal bank First Time is made up of three enterprising women, and is coordinated by Juana, a hard-working, 44-year-old woman, who lives with her partner. She works buying and selling fruits and vegetables at the municipal market. She is requesting the loan to buy tamarind, as it is one of the products that is in highest demand, and in this way hopes to increase her income. The other member of the group are Mercedes, aged 34, who has been selling new clothing in her region for six years, and Maria del Socorro, who is 45 years old and has been buying and selling fruits and vegetables at the municipal market for the past twenty years.

name: Hermes
description: Hermes is 34 years old and lives in his own house constructed of rustic materials. He lives with his wife and four children in the district of Sallique, a community dedicated to agriculture, trade, and raising livestock located in the province of Jaén, Cajamarca region, in the northern highlands of Peru.  He earns his living breeding and selling cattle in the surrounding villages of his district. He has requested a loan from Edpyme Alternativa for 3,500 Peruvian soles to buy two cattle to fatten and sell at a higher price.

name: Luzviminda
description: Luzviminda E. is from the village of Brgy. San Juan, Solano, Nueva Vizcaya. She is 38 years old, married, and has three school-aged children. To make a living, Luzviminda owns and operates a general store. While not the only means for generating revenue, the main source of income for the business comes primarily from selling a variety of products in the local community. Luzviminda has been engaged in her business for over 12 years and earns approximately 3,000 PHP a month.  In 2010, Luzviminda joined ASKI to gain access to financial services to help improve her living situation and ability to engage in business activities. Luzviminda is requesting a loan of 5,000 PHP, which will be used to purchase additional products to sell. This loan will be Luzviminda's first loan from ASKI. She plans to use the additional revenue generated from the business to financially support immediate members of her family.   About ASKI:  ASKI is one of the most successful microfinance institutions in the Philippines. It has 29 branches covering the Central and Northeastern areas. Its clients are mostly of farmers, fishepeople, and small entrepreneurs.  *Note: To maximize efficiency and reduce costs, this loan was posted using a template to automate the translation by Kiva.  Given that manual translation of entrepreneur profiles is costly, Kiva created this template for our Field Partner to allow them to continue to post loans in English while providing quality and accurate information to Kiva lenders.
town: Brgy. San Juan, Solano, Nueva Vizcaya

name: Tipapa Ole
description: Tipapa Ole R., 32 years old, supports two members of his family. His spouse is Safina R. and they are blessed with one child. He does wheat farming which he has been doing for the last five years successfully, due to good climatic conditions and a ready market for produce in his area.   This being his second loan, he is planning to spend twenty thousand to buy fertilizer and chemicals for his five-acre wheat farm and the remaining ten thousand on spraying the wheat. His plan for the anticipated profits is that he will expand his wheat farming to large-scale farming.  His hope is that he will become a large-scale farmer and own some farm machinery. He is a hardworking man and determined to achieve his target.

name: Emmanuel
description: Emmanuel is 33 years old.  He is married with six children between the ages 3 and 13 years old, and has two adopted orphans.  Emmanuel has been a motorbike taxi driver for three years. He gets up at 6 am and works until 11 pm everyday to transport people to their work places. He needs to pay $6 per day to the owner of the motorbike in order to use it.  Emmanuel has requested a loan worth 500,000 Rwf to buy his own motorbike taxi.  His goal is to send all his children to school, build a house for the family, and save for his future.
